headline: Nevish Line Erupts Anew as Callums Cape Storm Rages On
war_summary: Three hours have passed since our last edition, and the Nevish Line is burning again. All eight of its strongpoints fly Colonial colours, yet forty-five flag events mark the day's ledger there, three of them within two hours of filing, and the hourly toll has leapt from single figures to near forty on either side. Callums Cape is little quieter: seven exchanges inside two hours, the latest minutes before this report, with Naofa and Scouts Jest the storm centres and one post still unclaimed. Mooring County's flags have not moved since evening, but its casualty rolls swell past two thousand in two hours, The Wind Hills still the thunderhead. In the Weathered Expanse two bases lie in ruin while Wardens hold seven, both sides losing some four thousand over the day. Marban Hollow remains a three-way scramble with three posts neutral. Linn Mercy's fires, which roared at our last filing, have died down sharply, and Callahans Passage has logged no flag move since before midnight, though its daily losses run past fourteen thousand. It is the seven hundred and eighty-first day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
